previous_audits.verdict_rationale: Independent recomputation of the displayed finite-path formula slopes gives -1.7336, -1.4188, and -1.0776 for L_eff=5, 10, and 30, matching the packet. Independently fitting the stdout T_phys=7.5, H=0.25 kubo_true values gives slope -1.4356 with R2=0.9985, also matching the packet.
